stories.title: Layoffs, programs cancelled as Calgary drops mental health funds from city budget
stories.summary: Calgary's proposed four-year budget doesn't continue mental-health funding for community groups, which has forced some organizations to eliminate programs and lay off staff.

stories.title: New Alberta riding maps pass in legislature as NDP MLA kicked out of debate
stories.summary: Deputy NDP leader Rakhi Pancholi was escorted out of question period for what her party says was a calling out of the UCP's gerrymandering as 'cheating' to win the next election.

stories.title: Banff senior falls through thin ice while skating on Lake Louise and dies
stories.summary: A 70-year-old man from Banff was skating alone near the back of Lake Louise when he fell through thin ice on Tuesday evening.

stories.title: Calgary man charged in A.I. child pornography probe also linked to suspicious death, drugging cases
stories.summary: A man already facing a lengthy list of charges is now also accused of possessing child sexual abuse materials that police believe were created by artificial intelligence.

stories.title: CFL awards 2028 Grey Cup to Edmonton
stories.summary: Edmonton will host the 2028 Grey Cup not because of financial considerations, but because of the city's history of hosting major events, the amazing turnaround of the Elks football team and support from the community.

stories.title: Former Alberta justice minister Kaycee Madu cleared of professional misconduct
stories.summary: Kaycee Madu has had his professional misconduct finding quashed in a case that accused him of calling Edmonton's police chief to get out of a distracted driving ticket.

stories.title: Golden Knights net ‘huge’ win over Oilers
stories.summary: The Vegas Golden Knights are well aware they are in a divisional dogfight and came out flying Tuesday.

stories.title: Edmonton baker waits an hour for police while de-escalating erratic man: ‘Shouldn’t be my job’
stories.summary: The owner of King of Tarts says staff spent more than an hour trying to de-escalate an erratic man inside the Old Strathcona bakery while waiting for Edmonton police to arrive.

stories.title: Alberta takes symbolic stand against federal hate crime law, says it silences speech
stories.summary: The UCP government is expected to invoke the sovereignty act in the legislature and table a motion outlining ways Alberta could push back against the federal hate crime law.

stories.title: Stampeders fire defensive co-ordinator Slowik
stories.summary: The Calgary Stampeders have fired defensive co-ordinator Bob Slowik after missing the CFL playoffs for the second time in three seasons.
